title: Not All Criteria Matter: Importance-Aware Criteria Weighting for Rubric-Based LLM Evaluation
abstract: arXiv:2610.19915v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Rubric-based evaluation assesses the responses of large language models (LLMs) by aggregating the verification results of explicit criteria, yet not all criteria matter equally. However, existing methods commonly aggregate the verification results with uniform weighting, which assigns minor and overlapping criteria the same weight as essential ones and thus produces misleading evaluation scores. Although some methods prompt an LLM to directly assign weights, direct weighting requires a holistic judgment over all criteria that LLMs struggle to make reliably. To address these limitations, we propose Importance-Aware Criteria Weighting (ICW), which derives the weights of criteria from pairwise importance comparisons made by an LLM. translated_title: 并非所有标准都同等重要：面向基于评分标准的LLM评估的重要性感知标准加权
translated_abstract: 基于评分标准的评估通过聚合显式标准的验证结果来评估大语言模型（LLM）的回答，但并非所有标准都同等重要。然而，现有方法通常采用均匀权重来聚合验证结果，这使得次要和重叠的标准与关键标准获得相同的权重，从而产生具有误导性的评估分数。尽管一些方法通过提示LLM直接分配权重，但直接加权需要对所有标准进行整体性判断，而LLM难以可靠地完成这种判断。为了解决这些局限性，我们提出了重要性感知标准加权，该方法从LLM进行的两两重要性比较中推导出各标准的权重。具体而言，ICW将对所有标准的整体性判断转化为一系列两两重要性比较，检查并修正不一致的比较结果，并从主特征向量中推导出各标准的权重。
tldr: 提出了重要性感知标准加权方法ICW，将LLM对所有标准的整体权重判断转化为易于完成的两两重要性比较，并通过检查修正不一致的比较结果、从主特征向量推导权重，从而提升基于评分标准的LLM评估的准确性与可靠性。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes Importance-Aware Criteria Weighting (ICW), which transforms holistic criteria weighting into LLM-based pairwise importance comparisons, checks and revises inconsistent comparisons, and derives criterion weights from the principal eigenvector to improve the reliability of rubric-based LLM evaluation.
